spec_match.rationale: Teaches the exact ProfilerTrace trie (frames/stacks/samples), the ProfilerMarker enum verbatim from the explainer, the gc-with-stack interruption case, the missing-marker=idle rule, and the [CrossOriginIsolated] gating — every field name matches markers.md and PR #89.

interactive.rationale: Marker filter buttons and per-sample toggle buttons drive a real explorer; selecting a sample resolves its stackId chain through stacks to frames in the inspector.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises clickable stack resolution, marker filtering, and the idle/isolation rules; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the three sample shapes (stack+marker, marker-only, neither), the gc-interruption special case, the empty-filter state, and explicitly ties marker absence to non-isolated pages.

references.rationale: Links the markers explainer as the source of the shapes plus PR #89; the feature index carries the ChromeStatus link.

conformance.rationale: The enum and idle rules this page teaches are pinned in the suite as precisely-worded blocked contracts (marker-values-limited-to-enum, marker-absent-without-cross-origin-isolation) rather than fake-passing checks.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP driver run 2026-08-16 (f3-anatomy.png): selecting sample 3 resolved the full three-frame chain and rendered the gc-interruption explanation; layout filter narrowed to 2 samples, no-marker filter to 2, all filter restored 12; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts marker-anatomy-rendered against the full sample count at load; interactions are plain DOM updates with no error paths.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; pressed states flip background AND color together including the nested .mk badge (the nested-badge inversion rule).

accessibility.rationale: Filters are aria-pressed toggle buttons in a labelled group, samples are real buttons with aria-pressed selection state, the inspector is a labelled role=status region, and everything is keyboard-operable with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; sample rows are full-width grid buttons that stay within 360px.

openQuestions.title: Swap the worked example for a real recorded 153 trace when available
openQuestions.detail: The trace is honestly labelled as a worked example assembled from the explainer's shapes. Once a marker-capable Chrome 153 (OT/flag + COI + policy header) can run the live trace lab, record a genuine trace and replace/augment the example with it, keeping the labelling accurate.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button group filter aria-pressed selection list
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons with aria-pressed for filters and selections, group them with accessible labels, and reflect state in text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Filter and sample buttons are native buttons with aria-pressed; the pressed style inverts colours including the nested marker badge; the group carries an aria-label.

guidanceConsulted.query: connecting list item buttons to a detail inspector panel
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep item-to-detail wiring on real button elements with the detail region programmatically associated.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each sample is a button whose click writes to the aria-labelledby-associated inspector role=status region.

summary: An honest, clearly-labelled interactive walkthrough of the marker trace format: stackId chain resolution, marker filtering, the gc-with-stack case, missing-marker=idle, and the isolation gate — driver-verified with a clean console.
